title: Rajanīyasaṇṭhitam
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || ārame || || Atha- || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sādhu bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yaṃ ahaṃ Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā || pa || vihareyyan ti || || 4 Yaṃ kho bhikkhu rajanīyasaṇṭhitaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo ti || || Aññātaṃ Bhagavā aññātaṃ Sugatāti || || 5 Yathā katham pana tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsīti || || 6 Rūpaṃ kho bhante rajanīyasaṇṭhitam || tatra me chando pahātabbo || || Vedanā || || Saññā || || Saṅkhārā || || Viññāṇaṃ rajanīyasaṇṭhitaṃ || tatra me chando pahātabbo || || Imassa khvāham bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmī ti || || 7 Sādhu sādhu bhikkhu || sādhu kho tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsi || || Rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu rajanīyasaṇṭhitaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo || || Vedanā || || Saññā || || Saṅkhārā || || Viññāṇam rajanīyasaṇṭhitam || tatra te chando pahātabbo || || Imassa kho bhikkhave mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo ti || || 8-9 Atha || || la || || Aññataro ca so bhikkhu arahatam ahosīti || ||
